svg.aria-label: Pages mostly free but each holding a few live objects, preventing memory from being returned
svg.text: Fragmentation: free memory you can't use or return
a long-running heap after a burst of allocations is mostly freed
~90% of slots are free, but nearly every page still holds a live object, so none can go back to the OS (only
page 3 can). RSS stays high long after the burst. Allocators fight this by grouping objects by size and lifetime,
decaying and purging empty pages over time, and (in GCs or Mesh) compacting or merging partly empty pages.
